testCases.title: SEC - Broken Function Level Authorization: Read-Only token rejected on mutating endpoints
preconditions: InvenTree instance is running with Django REST Framework permission policies enabled
Read-only API token 'token-viewer-ro' generated with only 'part.view_part' and 'part.view_partcategory' permissions

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/category/ with categoryPayload and header 'Authorization: Token token-viewer-ro'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned with message 'You do not have permission to perform this action.'

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/ with partPayload and header 'Authorization: Token token-viewer-ro'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned; no new Part record is inserted into the database

steps.action: Send DELETE request to /api/part/1/ with header 'Authorization: Token token-viewer-ro'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 403 Forbidden returned; existing Part is untouched

postConditions: Database state remains unmodified; security audit log records 403 unauthorized attempt

testCases.title: SEC - Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA/IDOR): Horizontal isolation and ID enumeration guard
preconditions: Tenant A holds Part ID 101 with restricted visibility flag
Tenant B holds active token 'token-tenant-b' with no permissions over Tenant A assets

steps.action: Send GET request to /api/part/101/ with header 'Authorization: Token token-tenant-b'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found returned (or HTTP 403), preventing object existence disclosure to unauthorized caller

steps.action: Send PATCH request to /api/part/101/ with tamperedPayload and header 'Authorization: Token token-tenant-b'
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found or HTTP 403 Forbidden returned; target Part entity remains unchanged

postConditions: Part 101 retains original attributes and ownership unaltered

testCases.title: SEC - Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Sanitization on Part & Category metadata
preconditions: Authenticated session with write permissions
Target category exists (ID 1)

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/ with xssPartPayload and Authorization header
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 201 Created returned; payload is stored safely with HTML entity escaping or sanitized string

steps.action: Navigate to Part detail view in UI using Playwright and inspect DOM rendering
steps.expectedResult: Part name and description render as raw escaped text; zero JavaScript execution or alert dialog triggers occur

postConditions: No malicious script execution in UI or API clients; DOM safe from injection

testCases.title: SEC - SQL & ORM Injection Defense on IPN and Filter Parameters
preconditions: Authenticated API session active
Target database is PostgreSQL / SQLite backend

sqliPayloads: 1 UNION SELECT null, username, password FROM auth_user --

steps.action: Send GET request to /api/part/?search=' OR '1'='1 with Authorization header
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 200 OK returned treating payload as literal search string; database does not execute raw SQL; zero unhandled 500 errors

steps.action: Send POST request to /api/part/ with IPN: "'; DROP TABLE part_part; --", name: "SQLi Probe", category: 1
steps.expectedResult: API safely parameterizes and stores string as literal IPN or returns HTTP 400 validation error; database tables remain intact

postConditions: Database integrity verified; zero table alterations or SQL syntax leakages in error messages

testCases.title: SEC - Token Leakage, Forgery & Query Parameter Exposure Guard
preconditions: Valid authentication token 'valid-sec-token-12345'
Server logging set to standard INFO level

steps.action: Dispatch POST /api/part/category/ with 'Authorization: Bearer valid-sec-token-12345' (invalid auth scheme)
steps.expectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized returned with WWW-Authenticate header requiring 'Token' scheme

steps.action: Dispatch GET /api/part/?token=valid-sec-token-12345 without Authorization header
steps.expectedResult: API rejects URL query parameter token authentication with HTTP 401/403, preventing token exposure in proxy logs and browser history

steps.action: Inspect API error response bodies across 401 and 403 responses
steps.expectedResult: Error payloads contain only generic rejection details; zero server stack traces or internal environment variables leaked

postConditions: Sensitive tokens remain protected from logging, sniffing, or invalid scheme acceptance

testCases.title: PERF - High-Concurrency Multi-Facet Search Latency SLA under Peak Load
preconditions: InvenTree database seeded with 10,000+ Part records and 200+ Part Categories
k6 performance test runner configured with 100 Virtual Users (VUs)

steps.action: Warm up cache for 30s with 10 VUs hitting /api/part/ search endpoints
steps.expectedResult: Warm-up phase completes; response latency stabilizes under 500ms

steps.action: Ramp up to 100 VUs generating 500 RPS executing randomized multi-facet search queries for 4 minutes
steps.expectedResult: p95 latency <= 2,000ms; p99 latency <= 3,000ms; HTTP 200 status code on >= 99.9% of requests

steps.action: Assert error rate and database connection saturation metrics
steps.expectedResult: Error rate < 0.1%; zero HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts; database connection pool does not exhaust

postConditions: System recovers to baseline idle latency (p95 < 150ms) within 30 seconds of ramp-down

testCases.title: PERF - Paginated Part Catalogue Read Throughput & Cache Efficiency
preconditions: Catalogue populated with test datasets
k6 load test engine targeting GET /api/part/?limit=50

steps.action: Execute sustained 800 RPS workload of paginated catalogue requests for 3 minutes
steps.expectedResult: p50 latency <= 150ms; p95 latency <= 500ms across all paginated response envelopes

steps.action: Measure response payload transfer rates and serialization overhead
steps.expectedResult: Throughput >= 750 requests/second maintained without dropped connections

postConditions: Database CPU utilization remains below 70% during peak read load

testCases.title: PERF - Concurrent Category Tree Mutation & Lock Contention Under Parallel Writes
preconditions: Root category created for stress testing (ID 999)
50 parallel API workers initialized with mutating tokens

steps.action: Dispatch 50 concurrent POST requests to /api/part/category/ creating subcategories under parent 999
steps.expectedResult: All 50 categories created with HTTP 201 Created; zero deadlock exceptions (40001 / SQLITE_BUSY / Deadlock detected)

steps.action: Assert tree pathstring recalculation integrity and write latency
steps.expectedResult: p95 write latency <= 1,000ms; tree lineage correctly points to parent 999 for all 50 children

postConditions: Database table locks released cleanly; category hierarchy remains mathematically valid

testCases.title: PERF - Soak & Memory Stability Under Sustained Multi-Facet Queries
preconditions: Node and InvenTree application processes monitored with memory and connection telemetry hooks
Continuous 150 RPS background query load active

steps.action: Execute steady-state search and part retrieval traffic at 150 RPS continuously for 60 minutes
steps.expectedResult: System maintains consistent latency without performance degradation over the 60-minute duration

steps.action: Compare Resident Set Size (RSS) memory consumption between minute 5 and minute 60
steps.expectedResult: RSS memory growth <= 5% (demonstrating absence of ORM object or cache memory leaks)

steps.action: Verify database connection pool active vs idle connection counters
steps.expectedResult: Zero leaked connections; pool returns to baseline idle level upon test completion

postConditions: Zero memory leaks or zombie threads observed during soak run

testCases.title: A11Y - WCAG 2.1 AA Keyboard Navigation & Focus Hierarchy in Category Tree View
preconditions: InvenTree web frontend running in Chromium via Playwright
Category tree loaded with root and multi-level child categories

steps.action: Navigate to Part Management view and press Tab until focus reaches the Category Tree container
steps.expectedResult: Focus lands on first tree node with a visible, high-contrast focus indicator (contrast ratio >= 3:1)

steps.action: Use Arrow Down and Arrow Up keys to navigate between sibling category nodes
steps.expectedResult: Focus moves sequentially without requiring mouse interaction; active descendant or roving tabindex is maintained

steps.action: Press Arrow Right on a collapsed parent node, then Arrow Left on an expanded node
steps.expectedResult: Arrow Right expands child categories; Arrow Left collapses them; aria-expanded reflects boolean state ('true'/'false')

steps.action: Press Enter or Space on a selected node
steps.expectedResult: Category is selected; parts list updates to show category parts; zero keyboard traps encountered

postConditions: Tree view is 100% navigable via keyboard alone without relying on pointer devices

testCases.title: A11Y - WCAG 2.1 AA Dialog Focus Trap, Escape Key & ARIA Modality in Create Part Modal
preconditions: Web frontend operational in Playwright browser context
User opens 'Create Part' modal dialog

steps.action: Trigger 'Add Part' button in UI via keyboard Enter key
steps.expectedResult: Modal opens; focus automatically shifts to the first interactive field (Part Name input) or the modal container

steps.action: Assert modal DOM attributes and ARIA roles
steps.expectedResult: Modal element contains role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and an accessible name via aria-labelledby or aria-label

steps.action: Tab through all form fields to the final element (Cancel button) and press Tab once more
steps.expectedResult: Focus wraps around to the first focusable element inside the modal; background page content is inert and unreachable

steps.action: Press the Escape key
steps.expectedResult: Modal closes cleanly; focus is restored back to the original 'Add Part' trigger button

postConditions: Dialog maintains strict focus containment and predictable restoration upon exit

testCases.title: A11Y - Automated Axe-Core Full Page Accessibility Sweep on Part Views
preconditions: @axe-core/playwright test integration initialized in test harness
Part Index and Create Part pages rendered

steps.action: Execute AxeBuilder audit on the Part Management catalogue view with category sidebar expanded
steps.expectedResult: Zero violations with impact 'critical' or 'serious'; color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for standard text

steps.action: Execute AxeBuilder audit on the open 'Create Part' modal dialog
steps.expectedResult: Zero form label violations (all inputs have associated <label> elements or aria-label); zero missing landmark warnings

postConditions: Axe audit report passes with 100% compliance on automated WCAG 2.1 Level AA rules

testCases.title: A11Y - Screen Reader Error Announcements & Live Regions on Validation Failures
preconditions: Create Part modal open in browser
Form validation triggered with blank mandatory name field

steps.action: Submit 'Create Part' form with empty required fields
steps.expectedResult: Form validation triggers; invalid input element marked with aria-invalid='true' and linked to error text via aria-describedby

steps.action: Inspect dynamic error summary or alert notification banner in the DOM
steps.expectedResult: Error message container has role='alert' or aria-live='assertive', allowing assistive technologies to announce the failure immediately

postConditions: Assistive technology users receive clear, real-time auditory notifications of submission errors
